what: Round decorations (dots, pattern circles, ring circles) drift slowly up and down between −8% and +8% of their own height — tempos of 3·4·5s that differ, with staggered offsets mixed in, so the whitespace breathes like hot-spring steam — with look: up they only bob upward in place and come back (floating cubes·hands in isometric art)

options.--fx-dur: Half-length of one round trip (via style), default 4s — original 3s·4s·5s
options.--fx-amp: Sway width (via style), default 8% (of its height)
options.look: up: Moves only by --fx-amp upward from rest (0) (original 207 embed to { translateY(-3vw) } alternate)
options.--fx-delay: Start delay (via style) — a negative value starts that far into the progress so the pieces are staggered (207: -.4s·-1s·-.2s·-.8s)
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default ease-in-out — the original site uses easeInOutSine cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1)
